title: ScreenGammaAdjuster - Yet another plugin that adds screen brightness adjustment option

posts.author: Creta_Park
posts.body:
ScreenGammaAdjuster
by
Creta Park
This plugin just adds a simple screen gamma adjustment option for RPG Maker MV.
Recommanded MV version : 1.6.2^
License : MIT
​
GitHub repository (Download) :
https://github.com/Creta5164/rpg-maker-mv-screen-gamma-adjuster
Click to expand...
Just download js files in repository and put it into plugins to use it.
Also supports YEP_OptionsCore with extension plugin!
Screenshots
*Note that you can change displaying label text to you want to in plugin parameter settings.
